import ee, math
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (Bay Dosgris vicinity, south of New Orleans)
geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[-90.15, 29.25], [-89.85, 29.25], [-89.85, 29.50], [-90.15, 29.50], [-90.15, 29.25]]],
    None, False
)
region_km2 = ee.Number(geom.area(1)).divide(1e6).getInfo()

def mask_scale_rename_l2(img, sensor):
    # Cloud mask using QA_PIXEL
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0)
    shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0)
    cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0)
    snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0)
    mask = cloud.Or(shadow).Or(cirrus).Or(snow).Not()
    # Saturation mask
    sat = img.select('QA_RADSAT')
    satmask = sat.eq(0)
    img = img.updateMask(mask.And(satmask))
    # Scale optical SR
    opt = img.select([b for b in img.bandNames().getInfo() if b.startswith('SR_B')]) \
             .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    # Rename
    if sensor in ['LT04','LT05','LE07']:
        mapping = {'SR_B1':'blue','SR_B2':'green','SR_B3':'red',
                   'SR_B4':'nir','SR_B5':'swir1','SR_B7':'swir2'}
    else:
        mapping = {'SR_B2':'blue','SR_B3':'green','SR_B4':'red',
                   'SR_B5':'nir','SR_B6':'swir1','SR_B7':'swir2'}
    src = [k for k in mapping.keys() if k in opt.bandNames().getInfo()]
    dst = [mapping[k] for k in src]
    return opt.select(src, dst)

def get_collection(year, startMonth=5, startDay=1, endMonth=10, endDay=31):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, startMonth, startDay)
    end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, endMonth, endDay)
    cols = []
    if year < 1999:
        lt04 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) \
            .map(lambda i: mask_scale_rename_l2(i, 'LT04'))
        lt05 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) \
            .map(lambda i: mask_scale_rename_l2(i, 'LT05'))
        cols = [lt04, lt05]
    elif year < 2013:
        lt05 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) \
            .map(lambda i: mask_scale_rename_l2(i, 'LT05'))
        le07 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) \
            .map(lambda i: mask_scale_rename_l2(i, 'LE07'))
        cols = [lt05, le07]
    else:
        lc08 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) \
            .map(lambda i: mask_scale_rename_l2(i, 'LC08'))
        lc09 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) \
            .map(lambda i: mask_scale_rename_l2(i, 'LC09'))
        cols = [lc08, lc09]
    return ee.ImageCollection(cols[0]).merge(cols[1]) if len(cols) > 1 else cols[0]

def collection_with_fallback(year):
    col = get_collection(year, 5, 1, 10, 31)
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        col = get_collection(year, 1, 1, 12, 31)
        n = col.size().getInfo()
    return col, n

def avg_clear_fraction(col):
    n = col.size()
    def valid_band(i):
        return ee.Image.constant(1).rename('valid').updateMask(i.select('green').mask())
    valid_sum = col.map(valid_band).sum()
    mean_valid = ee.Number(valid_sum.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('valid'))
    mean_valid = ee.Algorithms.If(mean_valid, mean_valid, 0)
    n_info = n.getInfo()
    mv_info = ee.Number(mean_valid).getInfo()
    frac = (mv_info / n_info) if n_info > 0 else 0
    return frac

def composite_indices(col):
    comp = col.median()
    green = comp.select('green')
    nir = comp.select('nir')
    red = comp.select('red')
    sw1 = comp.select('swir1')
    ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI')
    ndmi = nir.subtract(sw1).divide(nir.add(sw1)).rename('NDMI')
    mndwi = green.subtract(sw1).divide(green.add(sw1)).rename('MNDWI')
    return comp.addBands([ndvi, ndmi, mndwi])

def areas_from_indices(idx_img):
    ndvi = idx_img.select('NDVI')
    ndmi = idx_img.select('NDMI')
    mndwi = idx_img.select('MNDWI')
    water = mndwi.gt(0.3).And(ndvi.lt(0.4))
    wetland = ndmi.gt(0.2).And(ndvi.gt(0.3)).And(water.Not())
    pa = ee.Image.pixelArea()
    water_area = pa.updateMask(water).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area')
    wet_area = pa.updateMask(wetland).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area')
    w = ee.Number(water_area)
    we = ee.Number(wet_area)
    return (w.divide(1e6), we.divide(1e6))  # km2

# Process years
y1, y2 = 1985, 2024
col1, n1 = collection_with_fallback(y1)
col2, n2 = collection_with_fallback(y2)

if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0:
    if n1 == 0: print(f"{y1} Images: 0")
    if n2 == 0: print(f"{y2} Images: 0")
    print("C1"); raise SystemExit

cf1 = avg_clear_fraction(col1)
cf2 = avg_clear_fraction(col2)
if cf1 <= 0 or cf2 <= 0:
    print(f"{y1} Images: {n1}, ClearFrac: {cf1*100:.1f}%")
    print(f"{y2} Images: {n2}, ClearFrac: {cf2*100:.1f}%")
    print("C2"); raise SystemExit

idx1 = composite_indices(col1)
idx2 = composite_indices(col2)

wa1, we1 = areas_from_indices(idx1)
wa2, we2 = areas_from_indices(idx2)
wa1, we1, wa2, we2 = [ee.Number(x).getInfo() for x in [wa1, we1, wa2, we2]]

# Validate areas
invalid = any(v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and (math.isnan(v) or v < 0)) for v in [wa1, we1, wa2, we2])
if invalid or we1 == 0 or we2 == 0:
    print(f"{y1} Water km2: {wa1}, Wetland km2: {we1}")
    print(f"{y2} Water km2: {wa2}, Wetland km2: {we2}")
    print("C3"); raise SystemExit

r1 = wa1 / we1
r2 = wa2 / we2
dr = r2 - r1

print(f"Region km2: {region_km2:.1f}")
print(f"{y1} Images: {n1}, ClearFrac: {cf1*100:.1f}%")
print(f"{y2} Images: {n2}, ClearFrac: {cf2*100:.1f}%")
print(f"{y1} Water km2: {wa1:.2f}, Wetland km2: {we1:.2f}, Ratio: {r1:.3f}")
print(f"{y2} Water km2: {wa2:.2f}, Wetland km2: {we2:.2f}, Ratio: {r2:.3f}")
print(f"ΔRatio (2024-1985): {dr:.3f}")

print("A" if r2 > r1 else "B")
